title.en: An Act to Authorize the Expenditure of the Proceeds of a Loan Now Being Applied for by the Government for the Construction of Certain Hydroelectric Power Projects and the Erection of a Fertilizer Plant
title.orig: An Act to Authorize the Expenditure of the Proceeds of a Loan Now Being Applied for by the Government for the Construction of Certain Hydroelectric Power Projects and the Erection of a Fertilizer Plant

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_216_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
That the proceeds of the loan of one hundred seventy-six million pesos being applied for from the credit institutions herein-above named is hereby appropriated, if and when the same shall have been granted, for the following projects:
1 The construction of complete hydro-electric power plants, including preliminary investigations, preparation of technical plans and specifications, acquisition of equipment, materials, supplies and services necessary therefor, building of dams, reservoir, transmission system and other accessory installations at-
(a) Ambuklao P48,000,000.00
(b) Itogon 70,000,000.00
(c) Maria Cristina 23,400,000.00 2 The diversion of the Lumot River and increasing the height of the dam of the Caliraya reservoir 6,000,000.00 3 The erection and construction of a fertilizer plant 28,600,000.00 Total P176,000,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 1, 1948.
